brand.name: Montage
brand.definition: A montage is an artistic technique or process of combining multiple separate images, video clips, or pieces of media into a single, unified composition.
brand.productPromise: Turn raw clips into a finished montage without becoming an editor.
brand.category: AI-assisted video storytelling and montage creation

audience.need: Turn existing footage into concise, coherent video without mastering a professional editing suite.

visualSystem.coreBehavior: Fragments align, sequence and resolve into a unified composition.
visualSystem.mark: A framed M drawn as a single editorial sequence path inside a video frame.
visualSystem.ratio: 16:9 is the primary cinematic frame; 9:16 and 1:1 are first-class outputs.
visualSystem.photography: Real-feeling documentary, travel, people, motion, process and environment. Avoid generic stock poses.
visualSystem.layout: Large fields of whitespace interrupted by purposeful frames, crops and sequences.

status: owner-approved creative direction; production identity in progress
